text:
Ivy Nakamura: Hi all :wave: I'm Ivy, starting today on DevEx (JST). Laptop should arrive this afternoon. Quick Qs: who do I ping for VPN/MDM and internal npm registry access? Also, is someone my buddy? Tiny brag: I make elaborate bento boxes on weekends 🍱.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Ivy Nakamura! MDM invite sent to ivy.nakamura@example.com. Please enroll your device and confirm here. If laptop tracking fails, reply and we'll escalate.

Eliot Ford: Hey Ivy :tada: I'm Eliot, your buddy for the first month. For npm registry, file an infra ticket and tag @Marta Ruiz. For VPN/MDM, follow the MDM link then upload an SSH key at https://id.redwood/internal-keys. We'll pair on the first PRs this week.

Kei Tanaka: Welcome Ivy! For internal npm you will get a token tied to your MDM key. After MDM enrollment, open a ticket with subject "npm token request" and include your employee ID. We use private-scoped packages so you'll need to add a registry entry in ~/.npmrc like:

```
//npm.internal.redwood/:_authToken=TOKEN_GOES_HERE
```

Marta Ruiz: Hi Ivy :wave: I just created the HW request so monitor + dock should ship. If you want stickers, mention a theme in the HW form and we'll add a small pack to the box. Also I can manually resend the MDM invite if you don't see it.

Ivy Nakamura: Thanks! I got the MDM invite and enrolled. Employee ID is E-77221. Also pls add extra stickers - I collect vinyl record ones.

Samira Gomez: Added Ivy to #devex and the onboarding tracker. Intro circle at 10:30 JST today  you'll get a calendar invite. Also pairing session with Eliot scheduled day 2 at 14:00 JST.

Eliot Ford: Quick SSH snippet we use for faster sessions:

```
Host dev-cluster
  HostName dev.internal.redwood
  User ivy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
  ControlMaster auto
  ControlPath ~/.ssh/cm-%r@%h:%p
```

Upload the pub key and ping me if you see "Permission denied (publickey)".

Ivy Nakamura: Uploaded the pubkey and opened the npm token ticket. Thanks for the dotfiles tip, Eliot. Also bringing a mini bento to the intro circle tomorrow 😄

Marta Ruiz: Confirmed npm token issued. You should be able to npm install @redwood/* packages now. Welcome aboard!

OnboardingBot: All onboarding steps for Ivy Nakamura show "in progress"  MDM enrolled, keys uploaded, hardware request pending. If anything stalls, reply here and the onboarding team will assist.

Ivy Nakamura: Awesome, everything's green on my side. Excited to join and meet everyone. See you at the intro circle!
